question: If atoms are substantial, do their effects arise only from impressions tied to multiple existences?
premises: Effects would then depend on impressions linked to multiplicity
inference: Assuming substantiality leads to dependence on impressions arising from various separate existences.
uncertainties: saṃskārotya is an unusual form, possibly saṃskārottha
plain_english: If they are substantial, then what arises would be only from impressions, due to connection with various separate existences.
